surgery.note: 投与から B 細胞回復までの 24 週 (168 日) は感染高リスク。緊急性のない手術は投与から 4-6 ヶ月空けるのが望ましい。CD19/CD20 陽性 B 細胞数を測定して回復確認

surgery.dose_dependent_summary: RA/AS/PsA/JIA 180日, not-severe SLE 180日, severe SLE 90日
surgery.source_title: 2022 ACR/AAHKS Guideline for the Perioperative Management of Antirheumatic Medication in Patients With Rheumatic Diseases Undergoing Elective Total Hip or Total Knee Arthroplasty
surgery.quote_excerpt: For patients with RA, AS, PsA, or JIA undergoing THA or TKA, withholding all biologics, including rituximab, prior to surgery and planning the surgery after the next dose is due is conditionally recommended. Perioperative management of rituximab has been a challenge given the long dosing interval of 6 months and the recognized risk of severe infection linked to its use. …
